observations: The page number «11» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «2*» on the right. L01-L16 end chapter 10, begun on p. 10 (JP2 0042, L15-L21).

L17: «C 45r» stands in the right margin beside the line, but no vertical bar in the line marks where fol. 45 recto of C begins. L19: the vertical bar between «examinationis» and «planetarum» marks the beginning of fol. 85 recto of M, which the note in the right margin, «M 85r», names. Both transcribed as margin notes.
L14: «Caldeis» is letter-spaced; «elhacil», the name of the Chaldeans (the Arabic in O, note 32) for the final centre, in italics. L24: «i. e.», id est.

The colon of L23 and the colons and the semicolon of N15, N17 and N18 stand after the thin space of the edition (8-14 px measured). N03: «{i:om.} O —», without a point after the siglum before the dash. N09: the omission in the lemma is printed as five points. N18: «(O quia)», the reading of O in roman type; «(sic)» with «sic» in italics.
Marks not transcribed: a speck above the bracket after the note number 33 (L15).
